scope.pointPolicy: Exactly one nearby regional-climate representative point per subregion. The point may be at or near the representative golf course, in a nearby town, or in the surrounding area, provided it represents the same local climate setting. Exact clubhouse, course-pin, fairway, or surveyed-coordinate precision is not required. Do not impose a universal fixed-radius cutoff; review regional proximity, coastal/inland exposure, terrain and elevation context.
scope.timezonePolicy: Use the IANA timezone stored on each representative point; aggregate source timestamps into the subregion's local calendar day.

geographicReadiness.timezoneValidation: IANA timezone validation passed during registry preflight
geographicReadiness.coordinateAcceptance: nearby regional point is sufficient; exact golf-course pin is not required

commonHistoricalBaseline.spatialCoverage: one existing representative coordinate per each of the 80 subregions
commonHistoricalBaseline.productionStatus: available on demand through the App historical archive adapter; complete regional archives are not stored as repository files
commonHistoricalBaseline.productionRule: Use the existing daily archive API adapter. Reuse the same subregion representative coordinate for all courses in that subregion. No CDS download, ERA5-Land, hourly bulk files, or station ingestion.

aggregation.dailyBoundary: local calendar day in the representative point's IANA timezone
aggregation.temperature: retain daily minimum and maximum air temperature; no daily mean air temperature required for the long-range display
aggregation.feelsLike: derive apparent-temperature low/high from daily Tmin/Tmax, daily mean dewpoint and daily mean wind; clearly mark as an estimate because inputs are daily aggregates and not time-paired
aggregation.precipitation: use daily precipitation sum in millimetres; historical wet-day frequency threshold is >=1 mm
aggregation.wind: retain daily mean and maximum wind speed in metres per second
aggregation.missingValues: remain null; never replace missing precipitation with zero

acquisition.mode: on-demand API retrieval when a region/monthly or long-range report is requested
acquisition.cache: share one archive request per representative coordinate and timezone within the current App session

independentValidation.purpose: Validate the common reanalysis baseline against station observations; station observations must remain separate from reanalysis records.
independentValidation.primaryStrategy: Use the relevant national meteorological/hydrological service station archive for each country when historical daily data and metadata are accessible.
independentValidation.fallbackStrategy: Use NOAA GHCN-Daily station records as a cross-country observation source where station coverage, variables, record length, licensing and provenance are adequate. GHCN availability must be assessed per station and element; it is not guaranteed for every subregion.
independentValidation.independenceRule: ERA5 and ERA5-Land products are not independent station-observation validation. Multiple products derived from the same underlying model/analysis family must not be counted as independent evidence.

enableOnlyAfter: all eight country registries and representative points pass structural validation
shared ERA5-Land acquisition and daily aggregation pass QA for every configured subregion
country and subregion coverage reports are complete
independent station validation is completed where adequate observations exist, with explicit coverage limitations elsewhere
regional climatology is built and independently inspected
the separate D19-D90 evidence contract is tested without altering D01-D16 live forecast data
formal V1 weights and App presentation/interaction remain unchanged

legacyCountryPilot.rule: JMA-specific CSV parsing, quality codes and station metadata must remain inside the Japan adapter. They must not become shared-core requirements for the other seven countries.

appBoundary.appInteractionChangeScope: Regional climate navigation now follows the approved country → macro-region → golf-cluster hierarchy; visual layout and departure-course flow remain unchanged.

phase1QualityPreflight.interpretation: All 80 representative points have coordinates and IANA timezones in the registry. Nearest 0.1-degree grid values are candidate mappings only. Actual returned grid coordinates, valid land-cell selection, station matching and historical acquisition remain pending.
phase1QualityPreflight.sourceDiscovery: Official archive discovery has begun; KMA, Vietnam national service, Singapore NEA and Indonesia SACA&D have documented access pathways or limitations. China, Thailand and Malaysia still require official archive discovery. NOAA GHCN-Daily is a fallback subject to per-station and per-element coverage review.
phase1QualityPreflight.nextGate: Complete station archive access and station inventory discovery, then run a one-subregion multi-year acquisition pilot before scaling to all 80 points.
